software_endpoint: qualified native C++ Linux-host HudGate; no ESP32 implementation

identity.generation_rule: nonzero strictly increasing for admitted PREPARE/RESET; Busy does not consume a generation
identity.reset: fresh generation plus external quiescence; old messages cannot cross reset
identity.tags: 128-bit SHA256 prefix; canonical HUD geometry/rectangles/u16 words; not authentication

fields: phase=Ready or Transferred; candidate_ready() is true
software_ready.means: all original HUD CRC/framing/reference/prediction/Huffman/Rice/range/output-tag checks passed; owned immutable candidate exists; historical Committed status is not a new ready token

external_transfer_ack.authority: trusted root memory writer/adapter; native test uses an actual copied sink and readback tag
external_transfer_ack.not_proven: physical DMA, cache coherency, QSPI transport, SDRAM write fence

root_commit_required: matching software HUD decoded_verified and output tag
all exact HUD words transferred to the candidate HUD bank
HUD external writes drained/bank matches candidate
accepted_cache_update: only matching root COMMIT after transfer ACK; identical commit retries idempotent
failure_contract: PREPARE failure emits no candidate-ready and preserves accepted cache
stale tokens do not replace candidate or accepted cache
ABORT discards candidate, including after provisional external transfer
previous HUD words remain immutable across failure/abort/new commit
COMMIT is root authority, not independently derived by software HUD decoder
missing_integration: mailbox/transport command encoding and endpoint driver
actual processor placement and timing/SRAM qualification
native candidate word DMA into the FPGA HUD bank
generation-qualified RTL join/abort and software commit ACK path
atomic YUV+HUD descriptor publication and panel vblank switch
